Are you busy with work? Can I help?
Hishi Akebono was there, wearing a blissful smile.

All those feelings of gratitude and joy come together,
and that's what makes the meal complete!

...Looks like she didn't notice.
We don't have much time, I need to hurry up and get things ready.

And you know, I finally figured it out.
...The feelings that people put into eating!

The lively sandy beach at night. Mouthwatering aromas and
the joyful laughter of Umamusume all around. And then—

For Hishi Akebono, who tackled even the harshest training with a smile,
now is the time to prepare a heartfelt feast!

Thank you, everyone! Thank you, Trainer!
Delicious food really is pure happiness!

You've been working so hard all through summer camp, Trainer.
I really think you should get some rest~.

A feast for Bono? Count us in!
She's always cooking for us, so we really want to return the favor!

To tell you the truth, Bono's Trainer wanted to thank you for everything,
and we just tagged along for the ride.

Whenever we eat the food Bono makes,
it cheers us right up and makes us want to give it our all tomorrow.

It was a quirky way to put it, totally true to Hishi Akebono,
but her smile and words were filled with deep trust.
Huh... for me?
Ahaha, of course!

There was a greengrocer too, so I'll go check that out.
Can I leave the meat to you?

Really? ...I see.
So that's how you feel, Trainer.

Not just that, but I also want to become an Umamusume who makes people want to put a smile on my face—
like 'true chankonabe.'

You're always the one making us happy, so...
we just wanted to make you happy too, you know?
It's something truly precious that we absolutely can't do without!

It's a shame we can't have dinner together tonight,
but let's do it next time! Well then, good work today~☆

I guess that's how you finally reach
a true 'thank you for the meal~.'

Thanks for always making such delicious meals!
I've been wanting to thank you for a long time.

Ehehe.
Trainer, you're like the dashi broth to me!

Just like all the different ingredients, it's made from so many different feelings.
That's what 'true chanko' must be~!
Oooh~. Ahaha, I get it now, I get it~.

...! Yeah! I'm so, so happy right now!
And I'm totally starving! Can I dig in already?

Of course!
I'm super, super happy~.

Hey, what should we do for dinner tonight?
The camp meals are nice and all, but since we're here, I could—
Itadakimasu!!

It's not that I was ignoring the gratitude of the people eating my food,
but I guess I never really thought about it before.
I know a great shop! They were selling tons of fish!
I used to think I wanted to become an Umamusume like chankonabe, bringing smiles to everyone's faces, but—

A few days have passed since arriving at summer camp with Hishi Akebono.
Before we knew it, the final day was already upon us.

What's all this food?! Skewers, yakisoba...
whoa, even ajillo?! ...Ah, and there's chankonabe too!

Got it! I'm sure there are other girls who want to say thanks too,
so I'll go round them up!

People say 'itadakimasu' before eating, right?
I bet that's the moment when the final seasoning is added!

Ehehe.
...You know what, Trainer?
Yup! If I'm the chankonabe, you're the broth, Trainer!
Whoa?! Wh-What brought this on all of a sudden?
Everyone...
Whoa, whoa, whoaaaa?!
First and foremost, we need ingredients. I decided to ask around among the other Umamusume to see if they knew of any good shops, but—

Phew~☆ I'm so full!
Thank you all so much for today!
Buono! Everything over here and over there is super buono!

I spent all this time only ever thinking
about making things taste good for others...
All right then... On three!

Thanks for your hard work, Trainer!
Summer camp sure was fun~.

So I want to truly embrace every 'itadakimasu,'
and make sure every single person feels completely satisfied from the bottom of their heart.
After cleanup was finished and everyone had returned to the camp lodge—

Before long, more and more helpers joined in.
After two hours of everyone dividing up the prep work—
